payload.posture: Read Exodus 24:1–11 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states moses reads the covenant, blood is thrown on the altar and people, and Moses, Aaron, priests, and elders ascend, see Israel’s God, and eat and drink. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
